If you want a girl's contact... ask her for it!
Don't flake on dates, unless you want to lose her trust
Girls love a swoll guy. Well, at least some of them do.
Get a job! Unless you want to be bumming off the girls. Not a good look.
How do you learn what a girl likes? Maybe ask her about it.
Conversation going on too long? You can always just walk away.
Set a Focus on the day screen. Skipping ahead to your next class then trains it for free.
Skipped hours on your Focus earn half what a real session would. Lazy, but not wasted.
Feelings only change when a scene ends. One great line won't save a bad evening.
Most girls won't sleep with you the day you meet. Some will. You'll figure out which.
No luck in bed? She probably doesn't want you enough yet. Desire takes more than one good date.
Most girls are on birth control. Want that to change? Talk to her about it.
Nothing takes during her period. Plan accordingly, or don't plan at all.
A birth goes on your calendar three days ahead. Be there. She will remember if you weren't.
At the birth she'll suggest a name. Don't like it? You're the father, speak up.
Got someone pregnant and made it official? Watch your DMs for the Sire Relations Office.
Rent is due on the 1st. Miss it for a week and the house is gone for good.
Every child takes a bit off your rent. The Office likes a productive Sire.
A child at home needs a cot, a mother under your roof, and its keep paid every week.
More comfort in the house means healthier children. Build the nursery.
Better at the job than it asks? Every point over the requirement is a raise.
Jobs with no requirements never pay a bonus. Train up and move on.
Miss a shift without a word and it's a full strike. Message your boss first and it's half.
Shifts are evenings and free days, so work never clashes with class. Dates are another matter.
Every course teaches you something at 30 marks. Check what before you enroll.
Can't tell if she's on birth control, or on her period? There's a course for that.
Every class has someone worth sitting next to. That's rather the point.
A gift she loves tells you what she likes. A gift she hates tells you too.
She keeps one memory of every scene. You can edit it on the summary screen. Nobody's judging.
Scroll up in a scene to take back something you said. She won't remember the first try.
Higher stats in what she admires make her warm to you faster.
Midnight to six is for sleeping. End the day early and you wake with full energy.
Seeing two girls who know about each other? One of them may turn up mid-date.
Curious about the world? The Help menu has the whole codex, bound like a book.
Witchcraft, Brewing and Bloomology teach you to make things. Look in your Bag once a week.
A potion does nothing in the bottle. Open your Bag and use it.
Some things in your Bag are for her, not you. Open your Bag while you're with her.
Not getting anywhere with her? There's a course that makes you a smooth talker. English, of all things.
Exams ask about what your classes covered. Paying attention in lectures turns out to matter.
Turning up to every class is a C. A B takes studying, and an A takes listening.
Miss an exam and it's an F. Nobody reschedules for the only man on campus.
There is a stair behind the hot pool in the Bathhouse. You didn't hear it from us.
Below, a pregnant woman hits like a cart. Ground her before she goes off.
What you find below isn't yours until you reach a checkpoint.
Relics from below are for keeps. So is the F you got for skipping the exam to fetch one.
